aiMarginImpact.recommendation: Invest in caching and batch processing to reduce AI cost impact

keyInsights: Gross margins remain above 92% across all scales — strong unit economics
AI hint generation is the dominant cost driver (46-65% of infrastructure costs)
Operating margins improve from 62.7% at 10k to 81.9% at 100k due to staffing leverage
Cost per user remains under $1.00 even at 100k scale
Break-even achieved at ~3,729 paid users (Starter tier)
Primary risk: AI API cost increases from provider
